## see something? just circle it.

tap the pen, draw around anything on your screen and ask about it out loud. senku only sees what’s inside your outline.

- hey senku, who wrote this? alright, reading those lines. find the source mark a few lines of any page and get the book and who wrote it. herman melville. it’s the opening of moby-dick, from 1851: “call me ishmael.”
